summary.oneLiner: India-based technology-enabled diagnostic services provider operating radiology, clinical laboratory and nuclear medicine centres across seven states through hospital-partnership and standalone models.
summary.business: Pramodini Medicare Limited provides technology-enabled diagnostic services - radiology (MRI, CT scan, X-ray, ultrasound with colour doppler, mammography, DEXA scan, intervention radiology and teleradiology), clinical laboratory (haematology, micro-biology, immunology, pathology and bio-chemistry) and nuclear medicine (PET-CT, SPECT and nuclear therapy) - to public hospitals, private hospitals, PSUs of the Government of India and medical colleges across tier I, II and III cities.
